titleZh: 中秋国庆之间的三个工作日：酒店房态收益最大化管理
titleEn: Three Working Days Between the Mid Autumn Festival and National Day: Managing Room Status for Maximum Revenue
summaryZh: 双节之间的三个工作日，酒店可用确认订单、房态基数和交接清单，减少已订房无法交付与后续补救。
summaryEn: In the three working days between the two holidays, confirmed bookings, room status baselines and disciplined handovers help prevent failures to deliver booked rooms and the remediation that follows.
contentZh:
中秋国庆之间的三个工作日：酒店房态收益最大化管理

中秋假期在9月25日至27日，国庆假期在10月1日至7日，中间是9月28日至30日三个工作日。

对酒店运营团队来说，这三天不该被当成一段普通工作日。中秋段离店、国庆段预抵、房间清扫、维修收口和上一班遗留的服务事项，都会在这段时间里叠在一起。房态收益最大化，不是临时提价，而是把已经确认的订单转成可按时交付的客房，减少因房态错误、交接遗漏和服务未闭环造成的无法交付与后续补救。

先统一数据口径：只认确认订单

每天从预订系统和前台交接记录中提取六类信息：到店日期、离店日期、连住天数、房型变化、取消或改期状态，以及尚未关闭的服务事项。

这条口径看似简单，却能避免不少麻烦。确认状态没有落定的订单，不能当作预抵安排；一项换房、改期或取消如果只在聊天里说过、没有更新到清单，下一班看到的就仍是旧房态。清单与系统必须一致，口头信息不能替代记录。

五栏清单：让前台、客房和值班经理看同一张表

第一栏是今日到店：房型、间数、连住天数和订单显示的到店信息。对接国庆段的预抵，要同时标出已经确认的服务要求，避免只锁了房、漏了服务。

第二栏是今日离店：离店房型、间数和离店节奏。客房部据此安排清扫、检查和可交付房间的顺序，不凭经验猜测高峰。

第三栏是变更与取消：换房、改期、取消逐条写明原状态、现状态、发生时间和经办人。这样，任何人都能追到一项房态为什么改变。

第四栏是房态基数与异常：每天都要列清脏房、清洁中、维修房、预抵和预离的间数；对不能按正常流程流转的房间，再单独写责任人和下一次检查时间。没有基数，异常就无从判断；没有责任人，异常只会留在交接里。

第五栏是未闭环服务事项：例如遗留物品、发票、投诉跟进、加床和已确认的备品要求。每一项都挂到具体责任人，记录处理结果后才能销项。换班不等于责任结束。

每天三次核对，把变化留在当天

早班核对当天预抵、预离和前一晚遗留事项；中班随着订单变更更新清单，并确认房态异常是否已有负责人；夜班形成次日要点，与下一班当面过一遍。

每次核对只需要回答三件事：清单与系统是否一致；今天发生的变化会不会影响明天的房态；尚未关闭的事项由谁在什么时间继续跟进。

这不是再增加一张表，而是把分散在系统、交接簿和口头沟通里的信息，收束到一个可以核对、可以接手的工作面上。

两个48小时节点，提前处理交接风险

只开两次短会，分别对应中秋段和国庆段开始前的48小时。第一次用于确认中秋段的预抵预离、离店高峰与遗留事项；第二次用于确认国庆段的房型、预抵、维修房和未闭环服务事项。9月28日至30日这段工作日不另开一套会议，而是并入国庆段交接准备。

参会人保持在前台主管、客房主管和值班经理。会议不回忆过程，只逐项确认：哪几项房态异常尚未关闭、谁负责、何时再查；哪些服务事项必须带到下一窗口；下一班拿到的是不是同一个版本的清单。结论写入交接记录即可。

高入住、长住客较多，或品牌已有刚性流程的酒店，不必另起一套机制。把这五栏并入现有交接表，指定维护人和交接时间，效果通常比另设复杂工具更可靠。

9月30日晚，把三天内出现的房态差错、交接遗漏和未闭环事项逐项整理，直接作为国庆段执行的输入。管理者要做的，是让下一班接到一份完整、可核对、有人负责的清单。
contentEn:
Three Working Days Between the Mid Autumn Festival and National Day: Managing Room Status for Maximum Revenue

The Mid Autumn Festival holiday runs from September 25 to 27, and the National Day holiday from October 1 to 7. September 28 to 30 are the three working days in between.

For a hotel operations team, these are not ordinary working days. Checkouts from the first holiday, arrivals for the second, room cleaning, maintenance closeout and unfinished service items from the prior shift converge in this window. Maximising room status revenue is not a last minute price increase. It means turning confirmed bookings into rooms that can be delivered on time, while reducing delivery failures and remediation caused by room status errors, missed handovers and unfinished services.

Use One Data Standard: Confirmed Bookings Only

Each day, pull six types of information from the reservation system and front desk handover record: arrival date, departure date, length of stay, room type changes, cancellation or rescheduling status, and unfinished service items.

This simple standard avoids common errors. A booking whose status is not confirmed cannot be treated as an expected arrival. If a room move, rescheduling or cancellation appears only in a chat and not on the checklist, the next shift still sees the old room status. The checklist and system must match. Verbal information cannot replace a record.

A Five Field Checklist for the Front Desk, Housekeeping and Duty Manager

The first field is today’s arrivals: room type, room count, length of stay and the arrival information shown on the booking. For National Day arrivals, mark confirmed service requirements as well, so that a room is not held while a service requirement is missed.

The second field is today’s departures: departing room types, room count and the departure pattern. Housekeeping can then sequence cleaning, inspection and rooms ready for delivery without guessing at the peak.

The third field is changes and cancellations: record the original status, current status, time of change and handler for every room move, rescheduling and cancellation. Anyone can then trace why a room status changed.

The fourth field is the room status baseline and exceptions: list daily counts of dirty rooms, rooms being cleaned, rooms out for maintenance, expected arrivals and expected departures. For a room that cannot move through the normal process, add the owner and next check time. Without a baseline, an exception cannot be judged. Without an owner, it simply remains in the handover.

The fifth field is unfinished service items: for example left belongings, invoices, complaint follow up, extra beds and confirmed amenity requests. Assign every item to a named owner and close it only after the outcome is recorded. A shift change does not end responsibility.

Three Checks Every Day Keep Changes in the Day

The morning shift checks that day’s expected arrivals, expected departures and the previous night’s outstanding items. The middle shift updates the checklist as bookings change and confirms that each room status exception has an owner. The night shift prepares the next day’s priorities and reviews them face to face with the incoming shift.

Each check needs to answer only three questions: does the checklist match the system; can today’s changes affect tomorrow’s room status; and who will follow up on each unfinished item and when.

This is not another layer of reporting. It consolidates information scattered across systems, handover books and verbal communication into one work surface that can be checked and taken over.

Two 48 Hour Checkpoints to Address Handover Risk Early

Hold only two short meetings, one 48 hours before the Mid Autumn Festival period and one 48 hours before the National Day period. The first confirms expected arrivals and departures, the departure peak and outstanding items for the Mid Autumn Festival period. The second confirms room types, expected arrivals, maintenance rooms and unfinished service items for National Day. The September 28 to 30 working days do not require a separate meeting series. They belong in the National Day handover preparation.

Keep attendees to the front desk supervisor, housekeeping supervisor and duty manager. Do not retell the process. Confirm item by item which room status exceptions remain open, who owns them and when they will be checked again; which service items must move to the next window; and whether the next shift receives the same version of the checklist. Record the conclusion in the handover log.

Hotels with high occupancy, many long stay guests or non negotiable brand procedures do not need to create a parallel mechanism. Fold the five fields into the existing handover form, appoint a maintainer and fix the handover time. This is usually more reliable than adding a complex tool.

On the evening of September 30, compile every room status error, missed handover and unfinished item from the three days. Use it directly as an input to National Day operations. The manager’s job is to ensure that the next shift receives a complete checklist that can be checked and has named ownership.
author: 迈创兄弟C&T（MarvelBros C&T）
